websiteDescription:
The waist belt inflatable PFD is designed to be worn around the waist for easy movement while boating, fishing and standup paddle boarding. The waist belt inflatable PFD is classified as a PFD whilst wearing it around the waist and with the bladder worn over the head. 
Features 
• Comfort fit 
• Halkey Roberts mechanism 
• Back up oral inflator 
• Supplied with a 24gm gas cylinder 
• Lightweight manual inflatable 
• Suitable for all States & Territories of Australia and New Zealand 
• To operate pull jacket out of bag, place over head and inflate 
• Adult size one size fits all 40-70kg and 70kg & over
